question: In which city is the India Gate situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India Gate** is a war memorial located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens and is one of the largest war memorials in India.
 
• The memorial is dedicated to the 82,000 soldiers of the undivided Indian Army who died during World War I a
